svg.title: MeetSync upload and processing pipeline
svg.desc: Full flow from browser audio upload through Flask, async worker, Deepgram, Gemini, Pydantic validation, and PostgreSQL write

sendPrompt('How does MeetSync use Deepgram for transcription?')
sendPrompt('What does summarizer.py do in MeetSync?')
sendPrompt('How does Gemini extract structured minutes in MeetSync?')
sendPrompt('How does Pydantic schema validation work in MeetSync?')
sendPrompt('How does MeetSync write meeting results to PostgreSQL?')
sendPrompt('What does the meeting record look like after successful processing?')
